changesApplied.changeMade: Added usageStats tracking after loading each impulse. Now updates loadCount++, totalTokens += tokenCount, and sets firstAccessedAt/lastAccessedAt timestamps.
changesApplied.reason: Critical gap - enables the learning system to track HOW MANY times each impulse is loaded and HOW MUCH token budget it consumes. Without this, the system cannot learn which impulses are heavily used vs rarely used, preventing optimization of context strategies.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - local mutation of impulse object before storing. No external dependencies. Enables downstream UI and aggregation to show usage metrics.
changesApplied.codeAdded: loadedImpulse.usageStats ??= { loadCount: 0, totalCost: 0, totalTokens: 0 }; loadedImpulse.usageStats.loadCount++; loadedImpulse.usageStats.totalTokens += loadedImpulse.tokenCount || 0; loadedImpulse.usageStats.firstAccessedAt ??= Date.now(); loadedImpulse.usageStats.lastAccessedAt = Date.now()

changesApplied.changeMade: Added usageStats initialization for newly created impulses. When task execution creates new impulses (artifacts), we now initialize their usageStats with loadCount=0, totalCost=0, totalTokens=0, and timestamps.
changesApplied.reason: Medium gap - ensures all impulses have usageStats structure initialized. Created impulses are outputs of task execution (e.g., analysis results, generated code). Without this, aggregation code would crash on undefined usageStats.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - simple initialization loop after impulse creation detection. No breaking changes. Prevents null pointer errors in UI.
changesApplied.codeAdded: for (const impulseId of impulsesCreated) { const impulse = _activity.impulses[impulseId]; if (impulse) { impulse.usageStats = { loadCount: 0, totalCost: 0, totalTokens: 0, firstAccessedAt: Date.now(), lastAccessedAt: Date.now() }; } }

changesApplied.changeMade: Added context_ratio calculation: impulseTokens / totalInputTokens. This metric tells the learning system WHAT PERCENTAGE of the prompt was impulse context vs other content (instructions, examples, etc.).
changesApplied.reason: High gap - enables learning system to measure impulse effectiveness. A high context_ratio with high success rate means impulses are valuable. A high context_ratio with low success rate means we're wasting tokens on unhelpful context. This is THE KEY METRIC for context optimization.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - pure calculation from existing data. Passed to backend for learning. No breaking changes to local state.
changesApplied.codeAdded: const impulseTokens = (task.impulseReferences || []).map((id) => _activity.impulses[id]?.tokenCount || 0).reduce((sum, t) => sum + t, 0); const contextRatio = tokens.input > 0 ? impulseTokens / tokens.input : 0

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed tokens parameter from single number (tokens.input + tokens.output) to breakdown object {input, output, cache}. Added contextRatio to the payload sent to backend.
changesApplied.reason: High gap - backend needs token breakdown to distinguish prompt costs (input) from generation costs (output) and cached token savings (cache). Without breakdown, learning system cannot optimize for prompt efficiency vs generation quality tradeoffs.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - changes API contract with backend. Backend must accept new schema. However, this is non-breaking because backend already expects this format (we were sending wrong format before).
changesApplied.codeAdded: tokens: { input: tokens.input, output: tokens.output, cache: tokens.cache || 0 }, contextRatio

changesApplied.changeMade: Added dual-write pattern: after reporting to backend, distribute task cost across used impulses and update local usageStats.totalCost. Then save activity to persist changes.
changesApplied.reason: High gap - implements dual-write pattern so local state matches backend state. Without this, UI shows zeros for totalCost even though backend has correct data. This enables cost attribution: which impulses are expensive vs cheap?
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - updates local state after backend success. Non-blocking (inside try/catch). Saves activity to persist. Enables UI to show cost metrics.
changesApplied.codeAdded: const costPerImpulse = cost / Math.max(task.impulseReferences?.length || 0, 1); for (const impulseId of task.impulseReferences || []) { const impulse = _activity.impulses[impulseId]; if (impulse?.usageStats) { impulse.usageStats.totalCost += costPerImpulse; } }; await Activity.save(_activity)

changesApplied.changeMade: Changed tokens parameter type from 'number' to '{input: number, output: number, cache: number}'. Added contextRatio?: number parameter.
changesApplied.reason: High gap - function signature must match actual usage. Without this, TypeScript would catch the mismatch. Backend expects token breakdown, not sum. contextRatio is new field for learning system.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - changes function signature. All callers must pass tokens as object. We updated the only caller (activity.ts). Backend integration layer now sends correct format.
changesApplied.codeAdded: tokens: { input: number; output: number; cache: number }; contextRatio?: number

changesApplied.changeMade: Updated MCP call to pass tokens as breakdown object {input, output, cache} and added context_ratio field to backend payload.
changesApplied.reason: High gap - backend API expects tokens breakdown and context_ratio. Without this, backend cannot analyze token efficiency or context effectiveness. This completes the data pipeline from calculation to backend storage.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk - passes data through to backend via MCP. Backend schema already expects this format. Non-breaking change (we were sending wrong format before).
